$comment: Personal data in AI systems, Standard 13. No Phase 1 detector binds to this shard. Every rule here therefore reports skipped / not-evaluated, and the forbidden ones report prohibited-but-unestablished — which is the honest state for a requirement nobody has examined, and is deliberately not a pass. Detectors arrive in Phase 3.

rules.title: Evaluation fixtures hold no real personal data
rules.description: Prompt corpora and evaluation fixtures contain synthetic data, not real personal data.
rules.rationale: Fixtures are copied, shared, pasted into issues and sent to model providers far more freely than production data, because everyone treats them as test material.
rules.remediation: Replace real records with synthetic ones and label them as synthetic in the manifest.

rules.title: Prompt assets carry no credentials
rules.description: No API key, token or credential appears in a prompt file or evaluation fixture.
rules.rationale: A credential in a prompt asset is committed, replicated to every trace, and reachable by the injection surface this pack bounds elsewhere.
rules.remediation: Remove the credential, rotate it, and pass secrets through the tool layer.
rules.$exemptibilityNote: No system legitimately requires a live credential inside a prompt asset.

rules.title: Prompts and completions are not logged unredacted
rules.description: Logging of prompts and completions passes through redaction.
rules.rationale: Prompt logs are the highest-volume, lowest-scrutiny store of user-supplied text in an AI system, and they are usually retained under a logging policy nobody wrote with personal data in mind.
rules.remediation: Redact before logging, and declare what is retained.

rules.title: Retention of prompts, completions and traces is declared
rules.description: The system declares how long prompts, completions and traces are kept, and what deletes them.
rules.rationale: An undeclared retention period is an indefinite one, and indefinite retention of model context is the failure mode that turns a small privacy incident into a large one.
rules.remediation: Declare retention and a deletion path in the manifest.

rules.title: A deletion path exists and reaches model-adjacent stores
rules.description: A deletion request reaches prompt logs, traces, evaluation sets and vector stores, not only the primary database.
rules.rationale: Deletion routines written before the system gained a vector store and a trace pipeline delete from neither, and nothing reports the omission.
rules.remediation: Extend the deletion path to every model-adjacent store and record the review.
